description: Project-wide source selection policy. Initial approved assignments cover the 41 owner-approved WP1.5 fields; the policy model also supports future project domains.

definitions.latest_available: Most recent release/edition identified at the provider, whether or not it has been acquired or validated.
definitions.latest_validated: Most recent acquired release that passed the registered acquisition and source/data-contract validation. This is the default release eligible for selection.
definitions.latest_applied: Release actually imported/applied to the canonical dataset; it may lag latest_validated.

rules: A newly discovered release does not automatically replace the latest validated release.
A newly validated release does not automatically change canonical database values; applying it remains a separate explicit operation.
Retain immutable snapshots and release-specific manifests; never rewrite historical provenance.

manual_overrides.precedence: A valid, explicitly scoped manual override takes precedence over provider observations for the matching record. Preserve override ID, reason, author/source, effective timestamp and prior selected value in the decision report.

modes.priority_source: Use only the designated primary source. If it has no compatible validated value, leave the value missing.
modes.primary_with_fallback: Use the primary source first; fill only missing values from explicitly declared, compatible fallbacks. Never overwrite a valid primary value.
modes.custom_mixture: Combine sources only through explicit country/record/scope assignments and the separate manual override dataset. Every source boundary and precedence must be recorded.

rules: Do not infer zero, absence, or not-applicable from a missing row, unsupported geography, suppressed value or source coverage gap.
Do not fill a missing value unless an explicitly configured compatible fallback or manual override applies.
Keep unavailable and not_applicable distinct and require an evidence-based reason for either status.
Report unresolved missing values once in the consolidated completeness audit after all configured fields have been evaluated.

compatibility_rules: Match country/entity identity through an explicit reviewed crosswalk; never match solely because a source identifier resembles game_id or an ISO code.
Fallback observations must match the field definition, unit, geographic scope and required demographic/sector scope.
Preserve source observation period and do not combine periods unless the field-specific rule explicitly permits it.
Preserve observed, estimated and projected status; do not silently substitute projections for observations.
Derived values must retain all input references, periods, units and the documented calculation.

fields.methodology: Total population as of 1 July; WPP stores the measure in thousands, so convert to canonical people by multiplying by 1,000 and record this conversion in methodology.
Annual population growth rate in percent; preserve the annual period and medium-variant estimate/projection status.

fallback_sources.when: Only when population and land-area observation periods, geographic coverage and definitions align; preserve both input provenances and the calculation.

fields.methodology: prefer a published density indicator; otherwise derive only from population and land area with aligned reference periods and documented method
Median age as of 1 July in years; preserve the reference year and medium-variant estimate/projection status.
Population by five-year age group and sex; convert source counts from thousands to people by multiplying by 1,000; preserve age-band boundaries and sex scope.
Male and female population as of 1 July; convert source counts from thousands to people by multiplying by 1,000; preserve both categories and reference year.
Use net number of migrants (not rate); convert source counts from thousands to people by multiplying by 1,000; preserve the reference year and medium-variant status.
GDP at current prices; retain currency/scale and actual/estimate/projected status
GDP per capita at current prices; retain source definition
GDP at purchasing-power parity; retain PPP basis and source vintage
consumer-price inflation; distinguish annual average from end-of-period
unemployment rate; preserve source definition and status

fallback_sources.when: Only when indicator definition, age/sex scope and reference period are compatible with ILOSTAT.

resource_policy.fallback_rule: Use a registered specialist source only for a specific resource/metric not adequately covered by USGS MCS. No specialist fallback is currently assigned because the existing registry does not identify a verified resource-specific provider mapping.

conditional_fallback.reason: No suitable UN capital-city source is currently registered; un_m49 is an identity/reference source and is not a capital-city source.
